sentences.text:
Mosin Mumtaz Pathan vs The State Of Maharashtra on 8 March,
2023

Author: R.G. Avachat
Bench: R.G. Avachat

In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
 Anticipatory Bail Application No.293 Of 2023
 Mosin Mumtaz Pathan
 Versus
 The State of Maharashtra
 ----

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr.Mohd. Aseem Mohd. Abdul Kaleem, Advocate for applicant
Mr.A.S.Shinde, App for respondent
 ----

Coram : R.G. Avachat, J.
Date : March 08, 2023 Per Court :-
The applicant claims to have apprehension of arrest in connection with Crime No.379
of 2022 registered with M.I.D.C. Cidco Police Station, Aurangabad, for the ofences
punishable under Sections 188, 273, 328 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal
Code and Section 59 of the Food Standard and Safety Act, 2006.
2. Issue notice to the respondent, returnable on 21.03.2023.
Learned APP waives notice for the respondent.

3. Till next date, in the event of arrest in connection with Crime No.379 of 2022 registered with M.I.D.C. CIDCO Police 2 9-ABA.293.2023 Station, Aurangabad, for the ofences punishable under Sections 188, 273, 328 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 59 of the Food Standard and Safety Act, 2006, the applicant be released on executing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand) with one surety in the like amount, on conditions that :-
( i) The applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station as and when required by the Investigating Ofcer.
(ii) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner.
